about_the_game:
The Demon Forest was born from the shaman's betrayal, and the town is shrouded in curses. As a hunter skilled in culinary arts, you must venture deep into the dangerous forest, hunt mutated demons, and use their flesh and blood to create sacrificial dishes that can appease the gods' wrath. On this journey, you will also meet charming companions. By recreating the delicious foods from their memories, you'll help them resolve their inner conflicts and listen to their life stories. This is a healing adventure that connects hearts through food and saves the world through cooking.

The Hunter-Chef Development Project

Arrange daily activities for the protagonist Zhuo Bao to improve attributes.

Can This Really Be Eaten? Unique Demon Cuisine

Hunt demons, collect ingredients, unleash your creativity, and process demon body parts in unexpected culinary ways to cook unique demon dishes.

Turn-based Combat System with Both Fun and Strategy

Exploratory map design where you click on tiles to discover hidden demons, terrain changes, and random events. Find the exit tile to proceed to the next level.

Original Part-targeting Combat System where each demon has fatal and ordinary parts designed based on real biological characteristics. You need to make strategic choices between ensuring survival and obtaining more materials: prioritize attacking fatal parts for safety, or risk attacking more parts for precious ingredients? With over ten types of demons and twenty-plus materials in free combination, experience rich strategic combat.

Enjoy Delicious Food and Chat About Life - Meet Your Special Someone

The town is home to charming NPCs with unique personalities - the highly intelligent but utterly helpless botanist Sister Ai Ye, the cute but cunning orchard girl Qi Qi, the romantic bard with a tragic past... They all have distinct taste preferences and life experiences. By creating dishes with specific tags (like nutritionally balanced golden fried rice requiring carbs, red meat, and fruit tags), gradually increase affinity and listen to their stories during warm dinner times, building deep bonds of friendship.

A fictional setting filled with shamanic culture, in a world where the balance between humans and nature is broken, connect hearts through food. You face not only dangerous demon hunting but must also listen carefully to each NPC's life story. When demonic energy spreads and the dark shaman appears, the truth hidden behind prosperity awaits your discovery.

name: Be My Guest

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 version 1607 or higher
  • Processor: 1.7 GHz Dual Core CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon RX 460 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon RX 460 or higher

short_description: Be My Guest is a 2D role-playing game that blends the social simulation system with rogue-lite deck-building elements. Players will experience the mixed gameplay of daily life and combat adventure.
supported_languages: English, Japanese, Swedish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
